<b>Survivor's Camp Supplies</b> is a [[Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, acquired from [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]] in [[Act 3]].

== Wish ==
[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is given a [[Delivery Wishes|fragile]] [[Courier's Swag]] with 5 health points by Tipp & Pill to carefully deliver it to [[Flick the Fixer]] in the [[Survivor's Camp]].

This Delivery can be repeated an infinite amount of times, allowing for a steady source of [[Rosaries]]. However, Tipp & Pill will only offer 2 Deliveries at a time. The most recently completed Delivery will never appear twice in a row.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Tipp & Pill 01.png!Tipp & Pill location in Bellhart
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Flea Caravan 01.png!Flick the Fixer location in Survivor's Camp
}}

== Route ==
The most optimal route goes through the hidden path in the [[Bellhart]] [[Bellway]] leading to the Marrow to reach the Survivor's Camp.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Survivor's Camp Supplies 01.png!Route through the Marrow
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Rosaries large.png|link=Rosaries|left|thumb|100x100px]]

By turning in the supplies to Flick the Fixer, he rewards Hornet with {{R|180}}.

{{Clear}}
